turns.learner: Hello! Can you give me an exercise on a, an and the?
turns.tutor:
Hello! Let me work through one example so you can see each step.
I have ___ pen. I look at the next word, "pen". Its first sound is "p", not a vowel sound. So I use "a", and the sentence is: I have a pen.
That is the rule: "an" before vowel sounds, "a" before the rest.
Right: She eats an apple. Wrong: She eats a apple.
Now it is your turn. Write a or an:
She has ___ orange in her bag. (answer with only the missing word)
